turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Hello Mr. Sharma? This is Inspector Arjun from the Mumbai Police cyber cell community outreach program.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Yes, hello. Why are you calling me? Is everything alright?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Everything is fine, sir. We are just calling senior citizens in your area to warn them about a new scam involving large transfers.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: A scam? I had a transaction of one lakh rupees recently, is there a problem with that?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: That is exactly why I am calling. If any stranger calls you about that one lakh rupees, please remember the police will never ask for your bank details over the phone.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Oh, I see. But what if they say they are from the bank and need a code to verify it?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: That is the trick, Mr. Sharma. Never share your OTP or your PIN with anyone, no matter who they claim to be.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: I was worried for a moment. So you do not need any information from me right now?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Not at all. I am only here to give you this a warning so you stay safe.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Thank you, Inspector. I will be very careful from now on.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: You are welcome, sir. Just keep your details private and have a good day.
